headline: Amber Enterprises India Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - In furtherance to our earlier intimation dated 11th July 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited (formerly known as IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited), a material…
detail: Updates - In furtherance to our earlier intimation dated 11th July 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited (formerly known as IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited), a material subsidiary of the Company, has filed the Draft Red Herring Prospectus dated 6th November 2026, on 7th November 2026 with the SEBI, BSE and NSE in connection with its proposed Initial Public Offer.
